title: Notice of Change to Key Dates for PAR-25-182 - Development of Psychosocial Therapeutic and Preventive Interventions for Mental Disorders (R61/R33 Clinical Trial Required)
purpose_tldr: Updates the receipt dates on PAR-25-182 (Development of Psychosocial Therapeutic and Preventive Interventions for Mental Disorders, R61/R33 Clinical Trial Required). The change shifts the June 2026 application due date by one year, with the rest of the PAR's schedule and other terms unchanged.
eligibility_tldr: Eligibility, scope, and review criteria for PAR-25-182 are unchanged. The notice affects only the date table; consult the parent PAR for institutional, PI, and clinical-trial-required details.
dos: Re-check your planned submission against the new June 15, 2026 cycle date
Treat all other PAR-25-182 requirements as still in effect, including clinical-trial-required policy
Confirm with your sponsored programs office that internal deadlines align with the new cycle
donts: Do not assume earlier or later cycles changed; only the cycles shown in bold italics moved
Do not file under the original date if planning a June 2026 submission
